# GitHub Agentic Surface Agent Instructions

## Owner

- `baldin_project_manager` for operating model changes; `baldin_full_stack_architect` for workflow enforcement.

## Scope

- Applies to GitHub-hosted Copilot compatibility and workflow assets.

## Do

- Keep `.github/**` as Copilot compatibility and execution layers over root/scoped `AGENTS.md`.
- Keep instructions, prompts, agents, skills, workflows, and docs aligned.

## Do Not

- Do not let `.github/**` contradict root or scoped `AGENTS.md`.
- Do not duplicate root policy in every Copilot asset.

## Validation

- Run the agentic validator when requested.
- Verify workflow path filters when instruction surfaces change.

## Handback Notes

- Report Copilot compatibility and CI trigger impact.
